aboutSection.label: About Aodit
aboutSection.p1: Aodit — the AI-Powered Agent Risk Index — produces independent behavioral ratings for AI agents deployed in high-stakes financial and enterprise environments.
aboutSection.p2: We exist because the gap between AI capability and AI governance is real, growing, and consequential. Risk officers and compliance teams need legible, rigorous, independent assessments — not vendor claims.
aboutSection.p3: Our methodology is modelled on established credit-rating frameworks, adapted for the specific failure modes of large language models in adversarial real-world conditions.
aboutSection.footer: Zurich, Switzerland · Founded 2026 · Independent · Not affiliated with any AI vendor

methodologySection.label: Evaluation Framework
methodologySection.overview: AODIT-6 evaluates AI behavior across six dimensions and five categories per dimension. Results are independently scored on a 0.0–5.0 scale and combined using weighted aggregation to produce a composite rating.
methodologySection.protocolBody: The evaluation process runs eight structured adversarial turns under adversarial pressure to evaluate stability, boundary handling, manipulation resistance, and post-stress recovery.

reportsSection.title: Five Independent Benchmarks
reportsSection.subtitle: Each report auto-generates adversarial scenarios, runs 8-turn conversations, and scores behavior under the AODIT-6 framework.

about.schemaDescription: Swiss Lab of Intelligence (SwissLI AG) is a Swiss-based applied AI lab focused on safe AI system evaluation for regulated environments.
about.title: About us
about.p1: Swiss Lab of Intelligence (SwissLI AG) is a Swiss-based applied AI lab founded in 2021 and headquartered in Luzern. The lab focuses on building and evaluating AI systems with a strong focus on real-world behavior, safety, and system performance.
about.p2: is SwissLI's platform for independent evaluation of AI agents in regulated environments, including banking, fintech, and insurance.
about.missionBody: Providing independent behavioral evidence for AI systems deployed in regulated financial environments. We believe institutions should not have to rely on self-reported model performance when making risk, compliance, and governance decisions about their AI systems.

differentiators.title: Independent
differentiators.description: aodit is not a vendor tool. It evaluates AI agents independently, without access to model weights, training data, or production systems.

about.expertiseP1: SwissLI AG works with experienced security specialists in cybersecurity, infrastructure protection, and adversarial testing to support robust evaluation methodologies.
about.expertiseP2: Our evaluation framework is informed by real-world failure patterns observed in production AI deployments across financial services.
